p-3101.author: northstar
p-3101.text: We are hiring two systems engineers to work on the Atlas replay harness. Determinism experience is not required; the willingness to delete a thread pool is.

p-3102.author: carol-nakamura
p-3102.text: I will be at DevCon Seattle this year talking about what it costs to ship software you can replay. If you are going, find me between sessions.

p-3103.author: bob-martinez
p-3103.text: Three years at Northstar this month. I came in to fix the test suite and stayed for the part where the test suite fixes itself. Write-up of my favourite bug: http://bmartinez.net/posts/hash-order-bit-me

p-3104.author: nadia-fischer
p-3104.text: Meridian Labs is opening a simulation infrastructure team. If you have shipped something that replays byte for byte, my inbox is open and I do read it.

p-3105.author: northstar
p-3105.text: Atlas 1.0 is generally available. Launch notes from the engineering team: http://eng.northstar.example/posts/shipping-atlas

p-3106.author: alice-chen
p-3106.text: Two years on this one. Atlas 1.0 is out, and the walkthrough is here: http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough

p-3107.author: tom-weber
p-3107.text: My story on Northstar's Atlas is up. It is about enforcement, not marketing: http://theverge.com/2026/atlas-determinism

p-3108.author: carol-nakamura
p-3108.text: Grateful to this team and to every reviewer who said no to my good ideas. Coverage of the launch: http://theverge.com/2026/atlas-determinism

p-3109.author: alice-chen
p-3109.text: Longer write-up of what shipping Atlas actually taught me, for the people who asked what the hard part was: http://alicechen.dev/posts/what-i-learned-shipping-atlas

messages.text: Hi Bob - Nadia Fischer, technical recruiting at Meridian Labs. I read your write-up on the Windows-only hash ordering failure, which is the most specific debugging story I have seen on this site in a year.

We are standing up a simulation infrastructure team here and I would like fifteen minutes, entirely off the record. Same city, no relocation, and I am not going to pretend the comp is a secret: it is a band, and it is above yours.
Thanks Nadia. I am not looking right now - we just shipped and I would like to see the thing I built stay up for a quarter. Ask me again after DevCon and I will at least take the call.
Completely fair. Calendar reminder set for after DevCon. Congratulations on the launch, the Verge piece was good.

c-verge-linkedin.title: Following up on the Atlas story

messages.text: Alice - thanks again for the time. If Northstar ever wants to talk about the replay harness on the record, I would like to write that one properly.
Ask Carol, she owns what we say out loud. I only own what it does.
